candidate.title: Add-guests endpoint can overbook seat-limited events by appending attendees without enforcing seatsPerTimeSlot
reports: no check against seatspertimeslot for seated events, so guest additions can exceed available seats
no seat-capacity check for events with seatspertimeslot, so appending guests as attendees can exceed the seat limit
addguests.handler.ts:44 — no handling for seated events (seatspertimeslot set but no bookingseat/seat-limit logic runs), so seat counts can be exceeded
seat-limited bookings bypass capacity: handler reads seatspertimeslot but never validates booking.attendees.length + uniqueguests.length <= seatspertimeslot
seated bookings: no capacity check before inserting attendees and no bookingseat records are created, allowing overbooking and divergence from seats-flow logic
seat-capacity is never enforced — attendees are created via raw prisma.booking.update regardless of remaining seatspertimeslot, allowing seated bookings to be overfilled
